reason: ReDoS through single-branch repeated extglobs (<=4.0.7) with no patched release (first_patched_version null on 2026-11-18; upstream fixes are still unmerged PRs). Exposure was already low: every picomatch pattern here comes from repo or dependency configuration (astro/vite/tinyglobby filters, changesets), never from a visitor. bun audit matches by version, so it still reports 4.0.7 and 2.3.2 and must be told to ignore the advisory. Remove this entry and both patches once picomatch publishes a fixed release.
